title: Website operating mode publication
invariants: digital_only, hybrid and commerce_only use one versioned Laravel-owned profile
edit, preview and publish permissions are separated
preview reports capability/content/route/SEO impact before publish
mode switches delete no business or CMS history
inactive capabilities block new creation while authorized history remains accessible
public capability reads are cache-versioned while creation guards recheck master DB state
one-click rollback creates a new published revision and revalidates caches
common/digital/commerce/mode-variant content stays in one modular CMS model
